verse.verse_2: By the moon as it Talaha.
verse.verse_3: By the day as it Jallaha.
verse.verse_4: By the night as it Yaghshaha.
verse.verse_5: By the heaven and Ma Banaha.
verse.verse_6: By the earth and Ma Tahhaha.
verse.verse_7: By Nafs, and Ma Sawwaha (Who apportioned it).
verse.verse_8: Then He showed it its Fujur and its Taqwa.
verse.verse_9: Indeed he succeeds who purifies it.
verse.verse_10: And indeed he fails who Dassaha.
verse.verse_11: Thamud denied through their trans- gression.
verse.verse_12: When their most wicked went forth.
verse.verse_13: But the Messenger of Allah said to them: "Be cautious! That is the she-camel of Allah! (Do not harm it) and (bar it not from having) its drink!"
verse.verse_14: Then they denied him and they killed it. So their Lord destroyed them because of their sin, Fasawwaha!
verse.verse_15: And He feared not the consequences thereof.
